title: PRD review convergence map and decision windows
creator: Aisha Kaur
description:
Background: Multiple recent PRDs for Dedicated and Private features have experienced delayed launches due to unclear review windows and ambiguous ownership of acceptance decisions across Engineering, Design, and Legal. This ticket creates a PRD review convergence map (visual + cadence) and explicit decision windows to reduce back-and-forth and accelerate acceptance sign-offs.

Scope: Define the convergence map for PRDs owned by product teams touching runtime, private deployments, and console UX. Produce a playbook with a meeting cadence, named decision owners per review lane, and fallback resolution paths when teams miss a window.

Out of scope: Implementing automated gating in the console; changes to contract language (legal will surface required edits but contract changes will be separate).

Goals: 
- Reduce average PRD signoff time by 40% for cross-team reviews.
- Provide a clear 3-step decisioning ladder (Contributor -> Reviewer -> Decider) for each PRD lane.
- Create templates and calendar events that PMs can instantiate per PRD.

Approach: 
1) Workshop with lead engineers, design partners, and Legal counsel to identify review artifacts and required inputs (telemetry, threat model, data residency statement).
2) Draft the convergence map and decision windows; circulate to leads for 48-hour feedback.
3) Run a pilot on one upcoming runtime feature PRD and collect metrics.
4) Iterate and roll out a lightweight playbook and calendar templates to all PMs.
acceptance_criteria: A visual convergence map (SVG + PDF) exists showing review lanes, owners, and 3 decision tiers
A one-page playbook with step-by-step PM checklist and required artifact checklist (PRD, design spec, threat model, telemetry dashboard links) is published in Confluence
Named decision owners for Eng/Design/Legal are added to the PRD template and a fallback escalation (VP or product director) is defined
Pilot PRD completed using the map with signoff time reduced vs historical baseline and measurement posted to dashboard
Calendar templates and PRD review invite descriptions are provided; at least two PMs have used the template in the pilot
